Q: How does Java Agent DEvelopment framework manage block() inside a behaviour and restart() A:

Its late for you but could be of interest for others.

  1. Its impossible to "resume" the execution in the sense of executing line n+1 within the action() method. Java only supports weak migration. doMove() is just a flag that will trigger the asynchronous migration of the agent AFTER the execution of the action() method.

  2. action() is a critical and thus uninterruptible section. restart() re-execute the whole behaviour.

  • BeforeMove() should be used to store the data you want and to destroy what is computer dependent (e.g :GUI) or not serializable

  • AfterMove() should be used to add the behaviours you want your agent to execute once the migration is done (and to load the data saved in beforemove() that you might want to give to these behaviours)

Q: Add current date to mysql database in PHP A:

Definition and Usage:
NOW() returns the current date and time.

Syntax:

NOW()

Example:

The following SELECT statement:

SELECT NOW(), CURDATE(), CURTIME() will result in something like this: 

NOW()                 CURDATE()     CURTIME()   
2008-11-11 12:45:34   2008-11-11    12:45:34

Example:

The following SQL creates an "Orders" table with a datetime column (OrderDate):

CREATE TABLE Orders  
(  
OrderId int NOT NULL,
ProductName varchar(50) NOT NULL,
OrderDate datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
PRIMARY KEY (OrderId)
)

Notice that the OrderDate column specifies NOW() as the default value.
As a result, when you insert a row into the table, the current date and time are automatically inserted into the column.

Now we want to insert a record into the "Orders" table: 

INSERT INTO Orders (ProductName) VALUES ('Jarlsberg Cheese')

The "Orders" table will now look something like this: 

OrderId     ProductName         OrderDate  
1           Jarlsberg Cheese    2008-11-11 13:23:44.657

Q: CRC mismatch on MFRC522 and Mifare Classic 1K A:

I modified the block data, and guess what? The CRC value remained unchanged. Later, when I debugged the toCard function, I realized that the last 2 bytes weren't being written to the buffer. I had copied this function from the internet but hadn't paid attention to this part. It's fixed now, and the CRC values match. By the way, with the initial value of 6363, the CRC becomes 0. Q: .NET 4.8 AllowAnonymous attributes A:

The issue isn't the app per se, its IIS. [AllowAnonymous] by definition cannot let you bypass NLTM authentication.

There's two levels of authentication in .net framwork, your IIS (server) auth, and the ASP.NET (your app) auth.

IIS auth > ASP.net auth, it overrules what you're doing (IIS runs first, so if it rejects the request, your ASP.NET code never executes)

So what you need to do is override IIS authentication directly by doing this:

web.config file

<configuration>
  <location path="MyController/MyEndpoint">
    <system.webServer>
      <security>
        <authentication>
          <anonymousAuthentication enabled="true" />
          <windowsAuthentication enabled="false" />
        </authentication>
      </security>
    </system.webServer>
  </location>
</configuration>

all this means is that you're telling the server (IIS) that "for requests to 'MyController/MyEndpoint' please ignore Windows auth... allow anonymous access"

This is good when you want just that ONE endpoint public and everything else locked down

OR, you can do this: if you want the whole site's access control to be handled by the application instead of IIS, enable Anonymous Authentication at the site level in IIS:

  1. Open IIS Manager (inetmgr)

  2. Expand Sites → click your site (the one hosting this app)

  3. Open Authentication

  4. Set:

    • Anonymous Authentication → Enabled

    • Windows Authentication → Enabled (optional; keep it on if you still want Windows identity available)

  5. Restart the site or recycle the app pool (or run iisreset)

After that, requests will reach your ASP.NET pipeline, and then:

  • endpoints with [Authorize] will still require authentication

  • endpoints with [AllowAnonymous] will be accessible without authentication
